successCriteria.description: The three private date helpers are removed from LeaveService: `grep -rn "private addMonths\|private startOfUtcDay\|private periodContaining" src/modules/leave/` returns no matches.
All four call sites use the imported free functions: two `startOfUtcDay(...)` calls in `cancel` and one `periodContaining(...)` call in `resolveBalance` no longer reference `this.`.
`npm run build` completes cleanly and the existing test suite still passes, proving the move is behaviour-preserving.

constraints: Edit ONLY src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts. Do not touch the shared module, repositories, routes, or DTOs.
Do not change the arithmetic, the ConflictError guards, the 10_000 safety bound, or the getUTC* accessors — the move must be behaviour-preserving.
Do not add any cross-module import other than `import { startOfUtcDay, addMonths, periodContaining } from '../../shared/date';`.
outOfScope: Any change to the shared date helpers in src/shared/date (accrual.ts / index.ts) — they are the canonical source and must not be modified.
Any change to leave-request behaviour, balance arithmetic, authorization, or audit/notification semantics.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The imported `startOfUtcDay`, `addMonths`, and `periodContaining` must be the canonical shared helpers re-exported from the directory barrel, so LeaveService no longer owns a divergent copy.

The free-function bodies must remain byte-for-byte identical to the deleted private methods (modulo `this.` prefixes and indentation), preserving the ConflictError guards, the 10_000 safety bound, and the getUTC* accessors.

integrationPoints.why: LeaveService now consumes the canonical shared date helpers instead of its private duplicates.
